newsitem.title: CHINA: China, Vietnam to speed up border talks.
newsitem.headline: China, Vietnam to speed up border talks.

text.p: China said on Tuesday it had agreed with Vietnam to speed up efforts to resolve their border disputes.

The official Xinhua news agency quoted Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen as saying the two sides agreed they should tackle more easily resolved issues first and put aside the harder issues for later.
Qian made the statement after meeting Vietnamese counterpart Nguyen Manh Cam, who is in Beijing accompanying Vietnam Communist Party General Secretary Do Muoi.
The effort to speed up talks referred to disputes over the land border between the two countries as well as waters in the Tonkin Gulf, the news agency said.
China and Vietnam have traded accusations over Chinese oil drilling in contested waters of the South China Sea.
China withdrew the drilling rig that sparked the latest round of tension but the two sides were unable to reach an agreement during talks held in Beijing.
